name: origin_get_analysis_results
description: Read an Origin report sheet and normalize its official result tree.

name: origin_get_analysis_operation
description: Read the settings tree for a recalculating Origin analysis operation.

name: origin_recalculate_analysis
description: Recalculate an Origin analysis operation with current or updated settings.

name: origin_run_analysis
description:
Run a supported Origin analysis and return structured metrics or output rows.

    Use ``include_output=True`` with ``output_sheet`` for analyses that create a
    worksheet. The ``analysis`` schema lists canonical names; aliases remain
    accepted for backward compatibility.

name: origin_linear_fit
description: Run Origin linear fitting.

name: origin_list_fit_functions
description: List common Origin nonlinear fit function names and parameters.

name: origin_nonlinear_fit_structured
description: Run nonlinear fitting with explicit function and parameter hints.

name: origin_save_analysis_template
description: Save an active workbook's recalculating operations as an OGW(U) template.

name: origin_open_analysis_template
description: Open an OGW/OGWU analysis template while preserving its operations.

name: origin_batch_process
description:
Run Origin batchprocess with an analysis template or active workbook.

    source_type supports files, folder, existing_xy, existing_xyz,
    existing_worksheets, and existing_ranges. For existing ranges, pass Origin
    range syntax through input_range, worksheets, fixed_range, or batch_range.

name: origin_clone_import
description: Clone an analyzed workbook and import each similarly structured file.

name: origin_ping
description: Connect to Origin/OriginPro and report basic status.

name: origin_capabilities
description: Report runtime capabilities; set ``show`` only to change Origin visibility.

name: origin_bridge_shutdown
description:
Ask the Origin GUI bridge to stop serving requests.

    By default this releases the Origin automation connection without closing
    Origin itself. Set ``close_origin=True`` to force-close Origin as part of
    shutdown.

name: origin_doctor
description: Diagnose Origin bridge configuration, status file, and connectivity.

name: origin_bridge_submit_task
description: Submit a supported Origin bridge method as a queued background task.

name: origin_bridge_task_status
description: Read status, result, or optional recent logs for an Origin bridge background task.

name: origin_bridge_cancel_task
description: Cancel a queued Origin bridge task or mark a running task for cancellation.

name: origin_bridge_list_tasks
description: List recent Origin bridge background tasks.

name: origin_list_xfunctions
description: List the controlled X-Function expert catalog and accepted arguments.

name: origin_run_xfunction
description:
Run an allowlisted Origin X-Function with schema-validated arguments.

    Call origin_list_xfunctions first. Unknown functions and parameters are
    rejected; range arguments cannot contain script delimiters. This is the
    expert route for supported Origin features without exposing arbitrary
    LabTalk construction.

name: origin_fft_filter
description: Apply an ideal/parabolic/band/threshold FFT filter to a signal.

name: origin_principal_component_analysis
description: Run OriginPro PCA with controlled output and plot options.

name: origin_one_way_anova
description: Run raw-data one-way ANOVA on two or more worksheet group columns.

name: origin_multivariate_analysis
description: Run K-means, hierarchical clustering, discriminant analysis, or PLS.

name: origin_nonparametric_test
description: Run an allowlisted OriginPro nonparametric hypothesis test.

name: origin_survival_analysis
description: Run Kaplan-Meier, Cox proportional-hazards, or Weibull survival analysis.

name: origin_plan_figure_spec
description: Validate a declarative FigureSpec and return the planned Origin operations.

name: origin_execute_figure_spec
description:
Execute a declarative FigureSpec.

    The current executor supports worksheet-backed single-panel and grid
    multi-panel figures with common plot types. Unsupported features are
    reported in the plan instead of being guessed.

name: origin_palette_catalog
description: List built-in palette names, semantic roles, and source links.

name: origin_plot_style_capabilities
description: List semantic plot style controls by chart type, Plot Type ID, or term.

name: origin_plot_style_setter_coverage
description: Report which implemented style registry entries have executable safe setters.

name: origin_get_graph_info
description: Inspect a graph page, its layers, axes, and plots.

name: origin_get_layer_info
description: Inspect one graph layer, its axes, and plots.

name: origin_export_graph
description: Export the active or named Origin graph to an image/PDF file.

name: origin_view_graph
description:
Render an Origin graph and return it as an image the model can see.

    Unlike ``origin_export_graph`` this leaves no file behind: the graph is
    rendered to a temporary PNG, returned as an image content block alongside a
    small text summary, and the temp file is deleted. Use it to visually verify
    a plot and iterate on it. ``max_width`` bounds the rendered pixel width to
    keep the returned image (and its token cost) small. Requires a
    vision-capable client to be useful.

name: origin_format_graph
description: Set graph long name, axis labels, legend visibility, and optional rescale.

name: origin_set_axis
description: Set axis scale, limits, tick step, and title.

name: origin_set_axis_break
description:
Add or remove an axis break on a graph axis.

    Hides the range between break_from and break_to on the chosen axis ("x" or
    "y"), so data on either side is shown closer together. position is the
    break location as a percent of the axis length; post_break_increment sets
    the tick spacing after the break. Pass enabled=false to remove the break.

name: origin_set_plot_style
description: Set common, color-map, contour, histogram, error-bar, and box styles.

name: origin_set_plot_property
description: Set one registry-backed plot style property if it is implemented.

name: origin_add_plot_to_graph
description: Add a worksheet X/Y plot to an existing graph layer.

name: origin_add_inset
description:
Add an inset (small embedded layer) to an existing graph.

    A new layer is placed inside the graph at left/top with width/height (all
    percentages of the page) and the worksheet x_col/y_cols are plotted into it.
    Give x_start/x_end and/or y_start/y_end to zoom the inset to a sub-range
    (useful for a magnified detail view); otherwise the inset auto-scales.

name: origin_merge_graphs
description: Merge existing graph pages into a publication-style multi-panel graph.

name: origin_create_graph_layout
description: Create an Origin Layout page containing linked graph pages.

name: origin_link_graph_layers
description: Link graph-layer scales and geometry to a source layer.

name: origin_copy_layer_scale
description: Copy Origin axis-scale settings from one graph layer to others.

name: origin_extract_graph_layers
description: Extract selected layers into separate Origin graph pages.

name: origin_browse_knowledge
description: List knowledge collections or browse one collection by slash-delimited path.

name: origin_query_knowledge
description: Search the local Origin knowledge base by keyword.

name: origin_run_labtalk
description: Execute LabTalk script text inside Origin and optionally return captured output.

name: origin_create_matrix
description:
Create an Origin matrix from 2D/3D data or a filled shape.

    xymap is (x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max). A 3D array creates multiple
    MatrixObjects; set dstack when its layout is rows, columns, depth.
    formula can fill cells with an Origin matrix expression using X, Y, i, j.

name: origin_get_matrix_info
description: Inspect matrix shape, object depth, XY mapping, labels, and data ranges.

name: origin_read_matrix
description: Read a bounded 2D window from one MatrixObject.

name: origin_write_matrix
description: Replace a matrix sheet or update one MatrixObject with numeric data.

name: origin_set_matrix_properties
description: Set matrix coordinate mapping, object labels, and image-view controls.

name: origin_transform_matrix
description: Transpose, rotate 90 degrees, or flip an Origin matrix.

name: origin_import_image
description: Import a local image, URL, wildcard stack, or multipage image into Origin.

name: origin_create_image
description: Create an Origin image or image stack from numeric array data.

name: origin_get_image_info
description: Inspect an Origin image's size, channels, frames, and media type.

name: origin_read_image
description: Read an Origin image or one image-stack frame into a bounded array result.

name: origin_process_image
description: Convert to grayscale, split RGB channels, or merge image frames.

name: origin_image_to_matrix
description: Convert an Origin image window into a new matrix sheet.

name: origin_peak_analyzer
description:
Run Origin Peak Analyzer with a saved theme or open its wizard.

    no_dialog is reproducible script mode and requires theme. modeless/modal
    opens the wizard and may omit the theme. A theme can represent baseline
    creation/subtraction, peak finding, integration, or OriginPro peak fitting.

name: origin_peak_baseline
description: Automatically create spectrum baseline anchor points with blauto.

name: origin_peak_analyzer_batch
description:
Batch-analyze multiple spectra using an Origin Peak Analyzer theme.

    Pass a full Origin XYRange or worksheet/x_col/y_cols. result_sheet must
    match the theme goal: integrate, baseline, peak_centers, peak_properties,
    or none. Sequential initialization is useful for related peak-fit spectra.

name: origin_plot_line
description: Import table data and create a line graph.

name: origin_plot_scatter
description: Import table data and create a scatter graph.

name: origin_plot_line_symbol
description: Import table data and create a line+symbol graph.

name: origin_plot_column
description: Import table data and create a column/bar-style graph.

name: origin_plot_histogram
description: Import table data and create a histogram graph.

name: origin_plot_box
description: Import table data and create a box plot.

name: origin_plot_table_id
description: Create a graph from table data using an Origin Plot Type ID and template.

name: origin_plot_dual_y
description:
Import table data and create a double-Y (two Y axes) graph.

    y1_cols are plotted against the left Y axis (layer 1) and y2_cols against
    the right Y axis (layer 2), sharing one X axis. Both lists are required.
    plot_type is "line", "scatter", "line_symbol", or "column".

name: origin_plot
description:
Create a table-based plot selected by ``kind``.

    A single parameterized entry point for common table plots and the Plot Type
    ID routes that each also have a dedicated ``origin_plot_*`` tool. For the
    common line/scatter/line_symbol/column routes, ``selected_cols`` uses the
    first column as X and the remaining columns as Y. A one-column selection is
    treated as Y-only. Matrix-range plots still use ``origin_plot_matrix_id``.

name: origin_plot_from_range
description: Create a graph from an existing Origin range and template.

name: origin_recommend_chart
description: Recommend chart types from table shape, column semantics, and optional intent.

name: origin_plot_auto
description:
Inspect table columns, select a suitable chart route, and create the plot.

    Provide ``intent`` when the desired comparison or relationship is known.
    Otherwise the router uses column types, cardinality, and selected X/Y/Z or
    error columns. Use ``origin_recommend_chart`` first when no graph should be
    created yet.

name: origin_plot_chart_atlas
description: Create a plot using chart-atlas intent routing.

name: origin_create_note
description: Create an Origin Notes window with plain text, HTML, Markdown, or rich text.

name: origin_get_note
description: Read an Origin Notes window and its syntax/view metadata.

name: origin_write_note
description: Replace or append Notes text, optionally changing syntax and rendered view.

name: origin_load_note
description: Load a local text, HTML, or Markdown file into an Origin Notes window.

name: origin_export_note_html
description: Export an Origin Notes window as HTML.

name: origin_delete_note
description: Delete an Origin Notes window. Requires confirm=true.

name: origin_list_project_folder
description: List Project Explorer contents, optionally filtering by Origin page type.

name: origin_set_project_folder
description: Change the active Origin Project Explorer folder.

name: origin_create_project_folder
description: Create a Project Explorer folder, optionally below a chosen parent.

name: origin_move_project_item
description: Move an Origin page or subfolder to another Project Explorer folder.

name: origin_rename_project_item
description: Rename a page or subfolder within an Origin Project Explorer folder.

name: origin_delete_project_folder
description: Delete a Project Explorer folder; recursive deletion requires explicit confirmation.

name: origin_save_graph_template
description:
Save a finished graph as a reusable user template with searchable metadata.

    The template is stored in the user template library (default
    ``~/.origin-mcp/templates``). Reuse it later by passing ``template=<name>``
    to any plotting tool. Provide ``plot_types``, ``roles``, and ``n_columns``
    to make the template easier to find via ``origin_search_templates``.

name: origin_search_templates
description:
Search the user template library for templates matching an intended plot.

    Ranks saved templates by plot type, data shape, tags, and keywords. Call
    this before plotting to reuse a matching style; each result carries a
    ``score`` and ``match_reasons``. Returns an empty list when nothing matches.

name: origin_delete_template
description:
Delete a saved user template (its .otpu/.json/.png) and drop it from the index.

    Returns ``deleted: false`` with reason ``not_found`` when no template carries
    that name.

name: origin_rename_template
description:
Rename a saved user template without redrawing the graph.

    Renames the template's .otpu/.json/.png files and updates the index. Returns
    ``renamed: false`` with a ``reason`` such as ``not_found`` or ``name_exists``.

name: origin_update_template_metadata
description:
Edit a saved template's searchable metadata in place (no redraw needed).

    Only the fields you pass are changed; omitted fields are left untouched. The
    .otpu template file itself is not modified. Use this to fix tags, description,
    or matching hints without re-saving from a graph. Returns ``updated: false``
    with reason ``not_found`` when no template carries ``name``.

name: origin_list_user_templates
description: List every saved user template, most recent first.

name: origin_filter_rows
description:
Keep worksheet rows matching structured conditions.

    Each condition is {"column": name_or_index, "op": ..., "value": ...} where op
    is one of eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, in, not_in, contains, startswith, isna,
    notna. Conditions are joined by combine ("and" or "or"). Provide output_book
    or output_sheet to write the result to a new sheet; otherwise the source
    worksheet is overwritten in place.

name: origin_drop_duplicates
description:
Remove duplicate worksheet rows.

    subset limits the columns considered for duplication (default: all columns).
    keep is "first", "last", or "none" (drop every duplicated row). Provide
    output_book/output_sheet to write to a new sheet instead of in place.

name: origin_fill_missing
description:
Handle missing worksheet values.

    strategy is one of: drop_rows, drop_columns, value (requires value),
    ffill, bfill, mean, median. columns limits which columns are affected
    (default: all). Provide output_book/output_sheet to write to a new sheet
    instead of in place.

name: origin_transpose_worksheet
description:
Transpose a worksheet so rows become columns.

    When label_column is given, that column's values become the new column
    headers; otherwise headers are R1, R2, .... The original column names become
    a leading "Field" column. Provide output_book/output_sheet to write to a new
    sheet instead of in place.

name: origin_merge_worksheets
description:
Join two worksheets on key columns (database-style merge).

    The left worksheet is book_name/sheet_name; the right is
    right_book/right_sheet. Specify the key with on (shared name) or with
    left_on plus right_on; when omitted, shared column names are used. how is
    inner, left, right, outer, or cross. Provide output_book/output_sheet to
    write to a new sheet instead of overwriting the left worksheet.

name: origin_concat_worksheets
description:
Concatenate the primary worksheet with one or more others.

    The primary worksheet is book_name/sheet_name; others is a list of
    {"book": ..., "sheet": ...}. axis="rows" stacks rows (a SQL UNION ALL,
    aligning by column name); axis="columns" places sheets side by side.
    Provide output_book/output_sheet to write to a new sheet instead of
    overwriting the primary worksheet.

name: origin_pivot_worksheet
description:
Reshape long data into a wide pivot table.

    index columns stay as rows, the distinct values of columns become new
    column headers, and values are aggregated with aggfunc (mean, sum, count,
    min, max, median, std). Provide output_book/output_sheet to write to a new
    sheet instead of in place.

name: origin_melt_worksheet
description:
Reshape wide data into long format (unpivot).

    id_vars columns are kept as identifiers; value_vars columns (default: all
    other columns) are unpivoted into a var_name/value_name column pair. Provide
    output_book/output_sheet to write to a new sheet instead of in place.

name: origin_import_table
description: Import a CSV, TSV, TXT, DAT, XLS, or XLSX file into a new Origin worksheet.

name: origin_import_file
description: Import a file using Origin's official Data Connector/from_file path.

name: origin_connect_data_source
description:
Create an Origin Data Connector from a local path or remote source.

    dctype selects a connector type such as CSV, Excel, JSON, or HTML when
    Origin cannot infer it. selection chooses a table, sheet, or subresource.

name: origin_get_connector
description: Inspect a worksheet's Data Connector source, selection, and settings.

name: origin_update_connector
description: Update an existing Data Connector and optionally refresh its data.

name: origin_refresh_connector
description: Refresh one worksheet from its persistent Data Connector source.

name: origin_connect_selection
description:
Import another connector selection into a new workbook sheet.

    For multi-table, multi-sheet, or multi-file sources, selection names the
    subresource. duplicate_analysis also copies analysis attached to the source
    connector sheet.

name: origin_disconnect_connector
description:
Disconnect connector metadata (sheet/workbook) or only unlock data.

    mode='sheet' disconnects the active sheet, 'workbook' removes all workbook
    connectors, and 'unlock' leaves the connector but unlocks imported data.

name: origin_refresh_all_connectors
description: Refresh all Data Connectors in the project or active project folder.

name: origin_read_worksheet
description: Read a window of Origin worksheet data as structured rows.

name: origin_write_worksheet
description: Write structured rows into a new or existing Origin worksheet.

name: origin_add_calculated_columns
description:
Add several worksheet columns from LabTalk formulas in one call.

    columns is a list of {"name": ..., "formula": ...}. Formulas use LabTalk
    column syntax. To reference another sheet, use the [Book]Sheet!index form,
    e.g. "[Book2]Sheet1!2 * 2" (col(...) resolves against the active sheet and
    ignores the [Book]Sheet! prefix, so use the column-index form for
    cross-sheet references).

name: origin_diagnose_worksheet
description:
Check worksheet data quality before plotting or analysis.

    Reports per-column dtype, missing count/fraction, and unique count, plus
    structured issues: empty_worksheet and all_null_column (error), high_missing
    and duplicate_columns (warning), non_numeric_column and constant_column
    (info). high_missing_threshold is the missing fraction (0-1) that triggers a
    high_missing warning. "passed" is false when any error-severity issue is
    found.
